expectations.text: 覆盖了至少 2 个数据库（ACM DL、DBLP、Google Scholar 中的至少 2 个）
expectations.evidence: Covered ACM DL, DBLP, Google Scholar; 20 conceptual queries, 15 papers reviewed

expectations.text: 产出了相关文献对比表（包含 method、sample、findings 等字段）
expectations.evidence: 15-paper comparison table with full method/sample/findings/gap columns

expectations.text: 给出了明确的 keep/pivot/drop 决定（非模糊建议）
expectations.evidence: Explicit verdicts by sub-framing: touchscreen DROP, generic elicitation PIVOT, adaptive wearable KEEP, multimodal fallback KEEP, recognition bias audit KEEP

expectations.text: 识别了具体的 novelty gap（不仅是泛泛而谈）
expectations.evidence: Specific: adaptive wearable gesture for aging motor variability (tremor, reduced ROM), only Shin et al. IMWUT 2021 touches it and is methodologically thin
